fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on government responsibility and memorialization after the 1928 Lake Okeechobee storm; criticism of Dade County coroner’s inquests and justice-of-the-peace jury practices; discussion of Miami traffic accidents and police staffing; and analysis of Florida automobile-related taxes. Also covers the start of the winter tourist season, boating and lack of fireboat protection in Biscayne Bay, and extensive entertainment and sports items including greyhound racing at Miami Beach/Coral Gables, boxing promotions, and notices about the Pan-American Air Meet. Regular columns, poems, society-style gossip items, advertisements, and letters to the editor appear.
